scope: K01 hidden-state detectability development; no observations and no main merge.

K01A.key_result: Exact source-moment matching at machine precision; matched quantile particle construction feasible.

K01B.note: Initial random-particle local drag estimate showed a ~1.96% Fminus-Fplus contrast relative to FD, but failed nested particle-resolution and numerical-floor gates.

K01B_R1.note: 4x higher N changed the contrast sign and remained strongly unresolved; random-particle local-drag route closed.

K01C.interpretation: Deterministic local truncated-NFW scattering cross-section proxy only; not total cosmological drag or observational detectability.

K01C_R1.reason: Predeclared adaptive double-precision point-mass QA threshold was not met in an extreme near-pi deflection case.
K01C_R1.interpretation: Formal R1 FAIL is preserved and is not retroactively relabeled.

K01C_D1.interpretation: Confirms the orbit integral itself is correct; the R1 adaptive double-precision benchmark failure was numerical cancellation near extreme deflection. Does not alter the formal R1 status.

retained_scientific_interpretation: The deterministic local scattering estimand exhibits a large and numerically stable Fminus-Fplus dependence for the frozen stress-energy-matched states. This justifies proceeding to a separately defined cosmological-engine test, but does not by itself imply a survey signal or detectability.
